title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Exodus 11: the warning of the last plague, from the silver and gold to Pharaoh's hardened heart.

questions.text: How many more plagues did Yahweh say he would bring on Pharaoh and on Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses he would bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt, and afterwards Pharaoh would let them go.

questions.text: What was every Israelite to ask of his or her neighbor?
questions.explanation: Every man and every woman was to ask their neighbor for jewels of silver and jewels of gold.

answers.text: Bread and water for the road

questions.text: What did Yahweh give the people in the sight of the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and Moses was very great in the land of Egypt.

questions.text: At about what time did Yahweh say he would go out into the middle of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses told Pharaoh that Yahweh said: 'About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt.'

questions.text: Who in Egypt would die, according to Moses' warning?
questions.explanation: All the firstborn in the land of Egypt would die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the firstborn of the female servant, and all the firstborn of livestock.

answers.text: All the firstborn in the land of Egypt
All the soldiers of Pharaoh's army

questions.text: The death of the firstborn would reach from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the firstborn of whom?
questions.explanation: It would reach from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill.

answers.text: The shepherd who is out in the field
The beggar who sits at the city gate
The female servant who is behind the mill
The fisherman who is by the Nile

questions.text: What would not even happen against any of the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Against any of the children of Israel a dog would not even bark or move its tongue, so that they would know Yahweh makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

questions.text: How did Moses go out from Pharaoh after giving the warning?
questions.explanation: Moses said Pharaoh's servants would bow down to him and say 'Get out', and then he went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say Pharaoh would not listen to Moses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Pharaoh would not listen, so that his wonders might be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

answers.text: That Yahweh's wonders may be multiplied in Egypt

questions.text: Who did all these wonders before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh's heart.
